tasks.title: What would you do?
tasks.text: Imagine you are walking in the steppe and you see a wolf. What would you do? Experts say that if you saw a wolf, you shouldn't run. If you ran, the wolf would follow you. If I were in that situation, I would stand still and make myself look bigger. I would also make a loud noise. Luckily, wolves rarely attack people.
tasks.q: Read the text, then retell it in your own words (5–8 sentences).
tasks.ru: Прочитай текст и перескажи его своими словами (5–8 предложений). Можно также пересказать текст урока из учебника.
hints: If you ran, the wolf would…
tasks.sample: Imagine you are walking in the steppe and you see a wolf. What would you do? Experts say that if you saw a wolf, you shouldn't run. If you ran, the wolf would follow you. If I were in that situation, I would stand still and make myself look bigger. I would also make a loud noise. Luckily, wolves rarely attack people.

tasks.q: What would you change if you were the director of your company?
tasks.ru: Что бы ты изменил, если бы был директором компании?
hints: If I were the director, I would…
tasks.sample: If I were the director, I would hire more auditors. I would also invest in a modern system for approvals. I would give people more training in English. I wouldn't have so many long meetings.

tasks.q: What would you do if you won a lot of money?
tasks.ru: Что бы ты сделал, если бы выиграл много денег?
tasks.sample: If I won a lot of money, I would buy a house for my parents. I'd travel around the world with my family. I'd also study abroad for a year. I wouldn't stop working completely.

tasks.title: Fear of speaking
tasks.text: Ainur has been afraid of public speaking since she was at school. For many years she avoided presentations. Last year she decided to change. She has been going to a speaking club for six months, and she has given three presentations at work. She still feels nervous, but she hasn't had a panic attack since March. She says she has never felt so confident.
tasks.q: Read the text, then retell it in your own words (5–8 sentences).
tasks.ru: Прочитай текст и перескажи его своими словами (5–8 предложений). Можно также пересказать текст урока из учебника.
hints: She has been afraid of… since…
She has been going to… for…
tasks.sample: Ainur has been afraid of public speaking since she was at school. For many years she avoided presentations. Last year she decided to change. She has been going to a speaking club for six months, and she has given three presentations at work. She still feels nervous, but she hasn't had a panic attack since March. She says she has never felt so confident.

tasks.q: How long have you worked in your job and done each of your main tasks?
tasks.ru: Как долго ты работаешь на своей должности и выполняешь основные задачи?
tasks.sample: I've worked at the refinery since 2018. I've been in internal control for several years. I've been responsible for procurement controls since last year. I've known my manager for five years.

tasks.q: Is there anything you are afraid of? How long have you felt like this?
tasks.ru: Есть ли что-то, чего ты боишься? Как долго ты это чувствуешь?
hints: I've been afraid of it since / for…
tasks.sample: I'm a bit scared of speaking English in front of many people. I've felt like this since I started learning English. I feel nervous when native speakers talk fast. I try to practise every day to overcome it.

tasks.title: A successful career
tasks.text: Lyazzat was born in a small town in 1985. She graduated from university in 2007 and joined a bank as an assistant. She has worked in finance for almost twenty years. She has been a manager since 2016 and has won two awards. Last year she moved to an international company. She says the most important thing in her career has been learning English.
tasks.q: Read the text, then retell it in your own words (5–8 sentences).
tasks.ru: Прочитай текст и перескажи его своими словами (5–8 предложений). Можно также пересказать текст урока из учебника.
tasks.sample: Lyazzat was born in a small town in 1985. She graduated from university in 2007 and joined a bank as an assistant. She has worked in finance for almost twenty years. She has been a manager since 2016 and has won two awards. Last year she moved to an international company. She says the most important thing in her career has been learning English.

tasks.q: Tell me about your achievements: what have you done, and when did you do it?
tasks.ru: Расскажи о своих достижениях: что ты сделал и когда?
tasks.sample: I've built a risk register for the whole refinery. I did it in 2022 with my team. I've also reduced the number of audit findings. My biggest achievement has been the new procurement controls — we introduced them last year.

tasks.q: Why do you want to work for an international company?
tasks.ru: Почему ты хочешь работать в международной компании?
tasks.sample: I want to work for an international company because I would like to grow professionally. I think it would give me new experience and better standards. I'm interested in working with people from different countries. It would also help my English.
